searched.title: Bambu PLA Silk+ Safety Data Sheet SDS20250928A06 (prepared by Shenzhen Tuozhu Technology Co., Ltd.)

documents.title: Bambu PLA Silk+ Technical Data Sheet (Bambu Filament TDS V1.0)
Bambu PLA Silk+ Safety Data Sheet SDS20250928A06 (prepared by Shenzhen Tuozhu Technology Co., Ltd.)
Bambu Lab Filament Hex Code Table: PLA Silk+
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values; the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 25 ± 4 MPa, elongation 1.5 ± 0.2 %, bending modulus 2150 ± 160 MPa, bending strength 30 ± 5 MPa, impact 8.5 ± 1.1 kJ/m²) are not stored. Raw-material properties (density, DSC melting and glass transition) sit in material.* / thermal.* keys.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 2130 ± 210 MPa, Z 1850 ± 140 MPa), melt index (14.5 ± 1.2 g/10 min at 210 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature ("/"), saturated water absorption rate (0.40 % at 25 °C, 55% RH), printing and storage humidity (< 20% RH, sealed, with desiccant), retraction length (0.6 - 1.0 mm) and speed (20 - 40 mm/s), chamber temperature (25 - 45 °C), max overhang angle (55 °), max bridging length (30 mm), support material (Support for PLA), spool material (ABS, temperature resistance 70 °C) and spool size (diameter 200 mm, height 67 mm), suggested annealing (50 to 55 °C, 6 to 12 hours), odor, skin hazards, chemical stability, solubility, chemical resistance, flammability and combustion products rows. The nozzle sizes (0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8 mm) are kept as a relation.
The TDS recommended chamber temperature (25 - 45 °C) is not written to thermal.chamber_temp: that key is a printer capability (number, template field chamber_temp_max), not a filament print setting.

SDS facts with no registry key are not stored: model "A06-xx", composition (PLA 60-80 %, TPU 20-40 % by wt), CLP "Not classified", and "Not hazardous goods" for sea, road and air transport. Its section 9 "No data available" for melting point and density does not override the TDS values.

Source disagreements kept for review: build plate (TDS lists Cool Plate SuperTack; the store FAQ says not compatible: recommended_plate is unverified with a conflict note); nozzle temperature (TDS 210 - 240 °C vs material-table wiki 190 - 240 °C ±10 °C for PLA*); bed temperature on PEI plates (TDS 35 - 45 °C vs material-table wiki 45 - 65 ℃ for PLA); AMS drying (PLA wiki "AMS HT/AMS 2 pro 55℃，8 h" vs drying wiki 45 ℃ for 12 h); bed drying (TDS and drying wiki 65 - 75 °C, 12 h vs PLA wiki hot bed 70℃，12 h). The product TDS values are kept; only the oven drying values are stored.
Marketing prose proves no number: "enhanced sheen and gloss", "enhanced layer adhesion", "superior resistance to bending and impact" (store page) are not stored.
Hex: the hex table names all 13 store colours exactly once ("White" ↔ "White (13110)" … "Titan Gray" ↔ "Titan Gray (13108)"); values read from the text layer and checked against the rendered page.

material.spool_type is neither stored nor marked not_published: no source names the spool (no "Comes with … Spool" bullet; the TDS gives only spool material and size), and the Spool option group ("Filament with spool" / "Refill") carries the choice.

The store page links documents that were not cached and not read: Filament RoHS (https://store.bblcdn.com/s4/default/93498d4068154749a8744f9cb662b857/Bambu_PLA_Silk_upgrade_ROHS.pdf) and the wiki guide https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/general/swaping-new-filament-with-bambu-reusable-spool. safety.certifications is therefore neither stored nor marked not_published.
No in-the-box list: no official packing list exists for this filament.
